project_name: Make My Perfume — Mobile-First Luxury Ecommerce Storefront
vibe_description: Clean white gallery canvas, crisp deep carbon text, razor-sharp 1px borders, subtle warm Champagne Gold (#D4AF37 / #C5A059) accents, and editorial typography. Inspired by haute perfumery lookbooks (Elysian, Byredo, Aesop, Bella Vita) with mobile-first thumb ergonomics, bottom-sheet cart drawers, sticky purchase action bars, transparent note pyramid breakdowns, and clear GST/COD/prepaid calculations.

typography.body_font: Geist Variable, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight

grid_structure.product_listing: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-6

announcement_bar.text: Complimentary shipping on orders over ₹999 · Extra 10% off on Prepaid orders
announcement_bar.typography: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-center py-2 px-4

header_bar.style: sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-950/90 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition-colors
header_bar.brand_wordmark_style: font-serif tracking-[0.25em] text-base sm:text-xl font-bold uppercase

hero_section.style: Cinematic luxury split banner with prominent fragrance hero bottle, gold overline badge, editorial title with italicized emphasis, and quick action dual CTAs.
hero_section.headline: A SCENT TO REMEMBER.
hero_section.subheadline: Fragrance is not what you wear. It is what remains. Handcrafted Eau de Parfum editions.

product_card.style: Minimalist gallery card with high quality imagery, hover subtle zoom (scale-105), quick 'Add to Cart' overlay/button, fragrance category tag, size indicator (e.g. 50ml / 100ml), star rating pill, and clean INR price display with GST inclusive badge.

scent_notes_accordion_or_pyramid.concept: Three-tiered visual pyramid card (Top Notes: 01, Heart Notes: 02, Base Notes: 03) with aroma icons, ingredient chips, and longevity/sillage meters.
scent_notes_accordion_or_pyramid.design: Clean 3-column bento or horizontal tiered layout with gold numbered pills.

cart_drawer.type: Slide-over right drawer with smooth overlay, persistent guest cart (saved to localStorage + server sync), coupon input ('PREPAID10' / custom), delivery threshold progress bar ('Add ₹X for Free Shipping!'), item quantity stepper, variant picker, and direct 1-click 'Proceed to Guest Checkout'.

checkout_experience.type: 2-column seamless checkout with zero forced login. Left: shipping form with Indian states/PIN code auto-fill helper + payment mode selector (Prepaid with 10% discount vs COD with ₹80 transparent fee). Right: sticky order breakdown displaying Subtotal, 18% GST itemization, PAN-India Shipping, Prepaid Savings, COD surcharge, and Final Payable Total.
checkout_experience.razorpay_integration: Supports Razorpay Modal trigger, test verification API, retry on failed payment, and explicit webhook confirmation view.

marketing_popup.concept: 10% VIP Welcome Newsletter popup with 24-hour cookie suppression, easy close '✕' button, and immediate discount code reveal upon submission.

placeholder_editing_support.concept: Clean 'Customizer / Content Editor' toggle in developer/store owner view to rapidly tweak hero title, pricing, announcements, reviews, and banner images on the fly with live preview.

accessibility_rules: All buttons must have explicit accessible names or aria-labels.
Dialogs and drawers must trap focus and close with Escape key.
High contrast text adhering to WCAG AA / APCA guidelines (minimum 4.5:1 for body).
No transparent dropdown or floating header backgrounds that bleed text.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete responsive mobile-first ecommerce application using React, Vite, Lucide icons, Sonner for toasts, and Tailwind CSS.
Implement the full catalog with search, mood/scent category filter (Fresh, Woody, Sweet, Spicy, Aquatic, Floral), sort (price, rating, new), and live search query bar.
Support persistent guest cart state with quantity updates, promo code application ('PREPAID10'), free shipping progress bar, and instant cart drawer.

Build a production-grade checkout experience calculating 18% GST, free shipping threshold (₹999), ₹80 COD surcharge if Cash on Delivery is selected, and 10% instant prepaid discount when Online Payment is selected.
Provide interactive Razorpay payment flow simulation with instant order confirmation, invoice summary generation, and fail/retry handlers.

Include rich product detail pages with variant size pills (50ml, 100ml), olfactory pyramid breakdown (Top, Heart, Base), real customer reviews with star ratings, and related fragrance recommendations.

Implement the 10% newsletter popup, About page, Contact form with validation & success state, Latest News blog grid & article view, and all legal pages (Privacy, Terms, Shipping & Returns, Refund Policy).
Add an interactive 'Live Content & Preset Customizer' tool so reviewers can swap hero banners, edit prices, toggle discount rates, and inspect the seeded data easily.
